Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

agree — to have the same opinion. Example: I agree with you.
disagree — to have a different opinion. Example: I'm sorry, I don't agree.
right — correct. Example: You are right.
wrong — not correct. Example: I think that is wrong.
true — in agreement with the facts. Example: That is true.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I agree with you.
• I don't agree.
• You are right.
• I think that is wrong.
• That is true.
